# API Pricing

Start building with Reka Research and Chat directly through our API to create scalable production workloads.

## Pay as you go

[Get started](https://platform.reka.ai) with no upfront costs. You only pay for what you use.

## Reka Research&#x20;

All prices are per 1k requests.

| Model                                                                                                                                          | Standard Requests | Parallel Thinking (low) | Parallel Thinking (high) |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------ |
| <b>reka-flash-research</b> <br /><small>reka-flash-research-20250708</small><br /><i>Supports complex, multi-step research across the web.</i> | \$25.00           | \$35.00                 | \$60.00                  |
